spec: p3m.assignment_1d, p3m.nearest_grid_point, p3m.assignment_weights, p3m.selfterm_fp, p3m.fd_coefficients, p3m.sinc_power, p3m.mesh, p3m.influence_at, p3m.quality_at, p3m.influence_box_correction, p3m.force_error, p3m.assign_charges, p3m.assign_squared_charges, p3m.kspace_energy, p3m.potential_hat, p3m.a2_tilde, p3m.field_ik, p3m.field_fd, p3m.interpolate_forces (bit for bit); p3m.fft3, p3m.kspace (within a tolerance)
generator: lake exe spec-vectors (NewenSpec.P3M, the *Float functions; SplitMix64, fixed seed)
encoding: every float is the hex string of its IEEE 754 binary64 bits; counts, orders, flags, nshape and integer coordinates are floats; a vector is x, y, z; a matrix row by row; a symmetric tensor xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz; a box is rectangular, a, b, c; grids in storage order z + Nz (y + Ny x)
layout_weights: p, u, nearest grid point, five weights (unused zero)
layout_mesh: box, nx, ny, nz, H, H_inv, cell volume
layout_influence_at: case (nx, ny, nz, order, nfdord, nalias, nshape, width, box), l, with_gamma, ghat, gammahat, q (reciprocal basis and mesh from reciprocal_box and Mesh::new of the box)
layout_quality_at: case, l, ghat, the two terms
layout_box_correction: ghat, gammahat, tl0_inv, delta_tl, corrected ghat
layout_force_error: q, sum_q2, volume, n_atoms, fpe, error
layout_influence_function: case, N, ghat per point, gammahat per point, Q
layout_assign_charges: nx, ny, nz, order, box, n_atoms, per atom r, q; grid
layout_kspace_energy: N, with_gamma, cell volume, eps0_inv, per point ghat, gammahat, re, im; energy, virial, per point the potential_hat re, im
layout_a2_tilde: N, with_gamma, sum_q2, per point ghat, gammahat, re R; a2_tilde, derivative
layout_field_ik: nx, ny, nz, box, per point phi re, im; per point Re E, Im E
layout_field_fd: nx, ny, nz, q, box, per point phi; per point E
layout_interpolate_forces: nx, ny, nz, order, box, atoms, Ex, Ey, Ez grids; per atom force
layout_dft: nx, ny, nz, seed, sign of the exponent; re, im of the transform (input sin(0.37 i + seed), cos(0.91 i + 2 seed))
layout_p3m_energy: case (grid 8^3), eps0_inv, atoms; k-space energy through dftFloat
